data.one_liner: Select files on the web platform with an iOS UI workaround
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package designed to let users select files on the Web platform. It includes a specific workaround for the issue where file selection popup menus on iOS/iPadOS web browsers are placed far away from the tap location.
use_when: You need a workaround for the incorrect popup menu positioning on iOS/iPadOS web browsers
You are building a Flutter web application that requires file selection
avoid_when: You are targeting non-iOS web platforms primarily
You need a comprehensive file picker solution across mobile and desktop platforms without web-specific workarounds
strengths: Fixes the iOS/iPadOS web browser file selection menu positioning issue
Uses standard XFile classes from the cross_file package
weaknesses: Intended as a temporary solution until popular packages resolve the iOS web issue
Recommended to use file_selector or file_picker for non-iOS web platforms
